title: The Rescue Triad Feature
description: The First Expeditionary Rescue Group at Diyarbakir Air Base, Turkey, nicknamed "The Rescue Triad," consists of HH-60 helicopters, HC-130J planes, and Pararescuemen.  These three elements work as a team to bring combat search and rescue capabilities to Operation Inherent Resolve.
keywords: pararescue, combat search and rescue, HH-60, HC-130J, Inherent Resolve, Diyarbakir, 1ERQG, Turkey
